t: Ubadah on what he pledged, and the three outcomes
a: وَمَنْ أَصَابَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا فَعُوقِبَ فِيهِ فَهُوَ طَهُورُهُ وَمَنْ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فَذَاكَ إِلَى اللَّهِ إِنْ شَاءَ عَذَّبَهُ وَإِنْ شَاءَ غَفَرَ لَهُ
p: Wa man aṣāba min dhālika shayʾan fa-ʿūqiba fīhi fa-huwa ṭahūruh. Wa man satarahu-Llāhu fa-dhāka ilā-Llāh, in shāʾa ʿadhdhabahu wa in shāʾa ghafara lah
m: Whoever does any of it and is punished for it, that is his purification. Whoever is covered by Allah, his affair is with Allah. If He wills He punishes him, and if He wills He forgives him.
